text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v2.8.1 -> route=redwood-text-gen, target=5% eu-west, change-window=22:00-02:00 UTC. kickoff ts=1719999999

maria: seeing a spike in 5xx on canary dashboard, baseline 1/min -> 12/min since +2m :rotating_light:

kevin: confirmed from traces — kvcache eviction rate up, a couple of runtimes reporting OOMs. snip of log: ```2026-03-17T22:01:12Z runtime: kvcache miss 87% | mem: 92% | oom:true```

sre_oncall: hold the ramp. do NOT push to 10%. anyone run a quick smoke?

jonah: agree with hold. request stop and pin eu-west to previous model version v2.8.0. we should abort automated percent increase.

deploy-bot: Abort initiated by jonah. Stopping further traffic shift, pinning eu-west to v2.8.0. rollback job queued id=rb-1720000100, eta ~30s. Logs will post here.

maria: creating incident IR-5678 and adding quick notes to release notes: "reverted quantized artifact that caused cache pressure in eu-west canary". tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

kevin: rollback logs: ```rb-1720000100: draining canary connections -> switching route to v2.8.0 -> success```. metrics back to baseline within 90s, 5xx down to 0-2/min.

anna_product: adding a customer-facing blurb to release notes draft: "Deployment paused due to internal performance regression; no customer data affected."

sre_oncall: good. next steps: schedule postmortem with eng-runtime + eng-ml, propose followups: prewarm KVC, reduce default batch-size for this artifact, add canary synthetic load tests. tentative 2pm UTC tomorrow.

jonah: thumbs up. for re-roll, we want a smaller canary (1%) and a KV cache warmup step in the pipeline. also recommend a short change-window extension to give time for observation.

maria: adding the above to IR-5678 checklist. marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
